name: Nameless Girl
source:
She came to Tokiwa Village several weeks earlier than [url=https://vndb.org/c3129]Oujo[/url] and like her, [spoiler]she is also a nameless eccentric shinigami girl[/spoiler]. Unlike Oujo, she doesn't have a stuffed toy to carry around in her arms but she has a nice small pet bird that she carries on her shoulder and uses it for her ventriloquism. She had met [url=https://vndb.org/c12871]Ryousuke[/url] one night while she was minding her own business at the so-called "suicide" cliff of Tokiwa village. In the nature of love on first sight, they immediately got very attached to each other, due to certain circumstances related to both of theirs psyches.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/922090-suika-as/faqs/58095]neo-X-saga's Walkthrough[/url]]
